description: Confirmation sent to a user when they sign up for a first aid / CPR training course via the First Aid Portal Resources tab.
subject: Course Registration Confirmed — $course ($reference)
body:
Dear $name,

Thank you for signing up. This email confirms your registration for the following course:

Registration Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Reference:       $reference
Course:          $course
Preferred Date:  $preferred_date
Registered:      $submitted_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What happens next:
• The University Health Center will confirm your final session date and venue.
• Please arrive 10 minutes early and wear comfortable clothing.
• If you can no longer attend, contact the Health Center so your place can be offered to someone else.

We look forward to seeing you there.

Kind regards,
University Health Center

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated confirmation from the University First Aid Portal. Please do not reply to this email.
